main_text.l: nem cum omnibus ecclesiis publi-cis: Deum Patrem, Filium,& Spiritum sanctum, fontem bonorum omnium; eoque nomine verè in scripturis comparatur Deus modo gallinæ pullos suos foventi, modo pastori, oves suas amanti, & ubique locorum quærenti, modo patri, qui filiorum miserias doleat. Quod autè Deum auctorem & approbatorem habet, quis jure improbet aut damnet?

Deinde quid quæso à verâ ecclesiâ Jesu Christi requires, quòd in hisce minùs offendas? Vis veras ecclesiarum notas? iis non minùs, quàm publicæ sunt conspicuæ; videlicet, sincerâ verbi divini prædicatione, legitimâ sacramentorum administratione, & accuratâ ecclesiasticæ censuræ, juxta Dei verbum, observatione.
Cives habent homines liberatos à servitute Babylonicâ, qui esuriunt & sitiunt Christum: licet inter eos etiâ multi hypocritæ & falsi fratres latitent. Pri-

page.notes: The facing page is only a sliver at the right edge and is cut off; it was left out. The mark after "observatione" is a stylised flourish, not a letter, and was taken as the sentence's end. The word "Jesu Christi" appears with a small gap in print; it was read as two words. The final word "Pri-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page.
